questions.q: If sum of coefficients in the expression of \left(\alphax^{2} - 2x + 1\right)35$ is equal to sum of coefficients in the expansion of $( x - \alphay{)}^{35},$~then $\alpha$ is equal to$
questions.solution:
Let

${S}_{1} = \left(\alphax^{2} - 2x + 1\right)35$

${S}_{2} = \left(x - \alphay\right)35$

Put~$x = y = 1$. Then, we get

${S}_{1} = \left(\alpha - 1\right)35$

$⇒ {S}_{1} = C0 35 \left(\alpha\right)35\left(- 1\right)0 + C1 35 \left(\alpha\right)34\left(- 1\right)2 + . . . . + C35 35 \left(- 1\right)35$

And,

${S}_{2} = \left(1 - \alpha\right)35 = - \left(\alpha - 1\right)35$

$⇒ 2\left(\alpha - 1\right)35 = 0$

$⇒ \alpha = 1$

questions.q: The term independent of $x$ in the expansion of the expression \left(1 + x + 2x^{3}\right){\left(\dfrac{3}{2}x^{2} - \dfrac{1}{3x}\right)}^{9}$ is equal to$
questions.solution:
Coefficient of $x^{0}$ in \left(1 + x + 2x^{3}\right){\left(\dfrac{3}{2}x^{2} - \dfrac{1}{3x}\right)}^{9} =$ Coefficient of $x^{0}$ in ${\left(\dfrac{3}{2}x^{2} - \dfrac{1}{3x}\right)}^{9} +$ Coefficient of $x^{- 1}$ in ${\left(\dfrac{3}{2}x^{2} - \dfrac{1}{3x}\right)}^{9} + 2 \times$ coefficient of $x^{- 3}$ in \left(\dfrac{3}{2}x^{2} - \dfrac{1}{3x}\right)9$
For \left(\dfrac{3}{2}x^{2} - \dfrac{1}{3x}\right)9\to {T}_{r + 1} = Cr 9 \left(\dfrac{3}{2}x^{2}\right)9 - r\left(- \dfrac{1}{3x}\right)r = Cr 9 \left(\dfrac{3}{2}\right)9 - r\left(- \dfrac{1}{3}\right)rx^{18 - 3r}$
$18 - 3r = 0 ⇒ r = 6, 18 - 3r = - 1 ⇒ 3r = 19$
$18 - 3r = - 3 ⇒ 3r = 21 ⇒ r = 7$
Required coefficient $= {C 9}_{6}{\left(\dfrac{3}{2}\right)}^{3}{\left(- \dfrac{1}{3}\right)}^{6} + {C 9}_{7}{\left(\dfrac{3}{2}\right)}^{2}{\left(- \dfrac{1}{3}\right)}^{7} \times 2$
$= \left(\dfrac{3}{2}\right)2\left(- \dfrac{1}{3}\right)6\left\{C6 9 \dfrac{3}{2} + C7 9 \cdot 2 \cdot \left(- \dfrac{1}{3}\right)\right\} = \dfrac{17}{54}

questions.q: The remainder when \left(2021\right)2023$ is divided by $7$ is$
questions.solution:
The remainder when $2021$ divided by $7$ is $- 2$. Hence, the problem reduces to finding the remainder when \left(- 2\right)2023$ is divided by $7$.

$= \dfrac{\left(- 2\right)2022 \times \left(- 2\right)}{7}$

$= - \dfrac{2 \times {2}^{2022}}{7}$

$= \dfrac{- 2 \times \left({2}^{3}\right)674}{7}$

$= \dfrac{- 2 \times \left(8\right)674}{7}$

$= \dfrac{- 2 \times \left(1 + 7\right)674}{7}$

Using binomial theorem, we get

$= \dfrac{- 2 \times \left(1 + 7k\right)}{7}$ where $k$ is an integer.

$= \dfrac{- 2 - 14k}{7}$

Clearly, the remainder when $- 14k$ is divisible by $7$ is $0$.

$= \dfrac{- 2}{7}$

$= \dfrac{- 2 - 5 + 5}{7} = \dfrac{5}{7}$

Hence, the remainder is $5$.

$

questions.q: The coefficient of $x^3 y^4 z^5$ in the expansion of $(x y+y z+x z)^6$ is
questions.solution:
We have
$\begin{aligned}
(x y+y z+z x)^6 & =\sum_{r+s+t=6} \frac{6 !}{r ! s ! t !}(x y)^r(y z)^s(z x)^t \\
& =\sum_{r+s+t=6} \frac{6 !}{r ! s ! t !} x^{r+t} y^{r+s} z^{s+t}
\end{aligned}$
If the general term in the above expansion. contains $x^3 y^4 z^5$, then
$r+t=3, r+s=4 \text { and } s+t=5$
Also, $r+s+t=6$
Solving these equations, we get
$r=1, s=3, t=2\therefore$ Coefficient of
$x^3 y^4 z^5=\frac{6 !}{1 ! 3 ! 2 !}=\frac{6 !}{2 ! 3 !}=60$

$S = \left(\alpha + p\right)m - 1\left(\left(\dfrac{\alpha + q}{\alpha + p}\right)m - 1\right)\left(\dfrac{\alpha + q}{\alpha + p}\right) - 1 = \dfrac{\left(\alpha + q\right)m - \left(\alpha + p\right)m}{q - p}$
